reason: I can't put a vendor with no customers, no references and no SOC 2 report inline in our order path, even for free, because it would fail our vendor review before anyone looked at the product. Another hop in front of every agent trade also means more latency and a new way for orders to fail, and I'd be the one explaining that to the regulators and the board.
objection: It's an unaudited early-stage startup asking to sit between our customers' agents and execution. If it goes down or gets breached, our orders stop or go wrong, and 'SOC 2 planned' gives me nothing to show compliance or examiners.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two or three reference brokers already running it in production, with published latency numbers and a fail-open or bypass mode we control. Then I'd look at the design partner pilot for next year's budget.
